reflections.summary: Temporal: one anchor per sentence, other events hang off it with :overlap, every event gets a parent, no depends-on for vague present adverbs, copular identity left out. Classifiers become :quant+:unit (also 1); adverbs are nodes. No implicit arguments. Attachment rules for aspectual-verb relatives, shared modifiers, describing clauses, part-of and medium. Aspect rules for habitual, already+stop and naming passives. Prefer lexical frames over -91; 不过 is but-91; have-degree-91; 由于 is :reason; split coordinated compounds. No :wiki, title brackets as ops, place-name modifiers as :place. No coref chains for incidental place modifiers.

Fix temporal anchoring (identity-91 root, aspectual verbs, past-time adverbs, result-now depends-on, have-degree-91 exception), superlative ARG2/ARG5 and 上 postposition, Chinese PropBank role numbering, attributes on identity-91/have-degree-91, shared-subject re-entrancy, fused negation, narrowed already+stop rule, nested and-pairs, coref checklist.

Fix misleading belonging-verb sense example and make PropBank frame lookup (whole token, all senses) mandatory; specify concept for fused negation; specific periodical entity types; explicit identity-91 temporal triples; stative verbs keep state aspect; no unexpressed non-core relations.

Reify clause-level reason/purpose (have-reason-91/have-purpose-91); split verb+量/率/额 compounds and use have-quant-91 for amounts reached; bare-verb frame for V至/V到 tokens; widen Chinese ARG0-theme warning; narrow shared-subject re-entrancy, head-noun/appositive/旗下 rules; individual-person, middle-dot op, agent nouns; fix temporal rules for absolute dates, purpose, cause/earlier relatives, depends-on, decade; aspect/modal/coref details.

Keep the reach/fall verb as root (ARG0 theme, performance) with have-quant-91 attribute-free; no sentence-initial one-arg but-91; measure-compound inner verb without aspect/modal; format/part noun as argument with publication :part-of, A in 由A改为B is ARG1; trailing contains-clauses as ARGn-of process; role noun with name -> role predicate (Chinese -91 names, per critique); nested abstract predicates get no aspect/temporal/modal; date :overlap event; earlier-sentence anchoring only when sequence marked; :era year number; printing example.

Define entities at first mention and re-enter later; part-of only (no inverse :part), for any part/format argument; enforce ARG0-only rolesets (checklist); no node for a connective linking to an earlier sentence; stricter :same-event; narrative change defaults to :overlap; trailing clause attaches to the creation verb's own argument. Trimmed intro/header text to stay under the limit.

Freed space (intro, §1 example, type list, checklist). Added: but-91 for 虽然…但; 以X为目的 as identity-91 with the noun; topic-list :example with 等 as last op; parenthetical clauses as and-conjuncts; consecutive for sequence adverbs, no node for 就/便; mandatory :quote, speaker as ARG0, saying-verb modal full-affirmative, hedged-copula complements author-affirmative; one-time claims performance; aspectual verbs with agent roles share the subject, their nominal objects are process; symmetric 与 → and subject; spouse titles have-rel-role-91; own-noun repeats get a node plus coref; no coref for generic kinds; individual-person for any named being, planet; head+modifier compound split; 其中 as ARG5 in superlatives; implicit-argument for headless superlatives; whole-token lookup for V是; frequency adverbs.

Org/publication pronouns re-entered or coreffed to the entity; mandatory :quote with speaker entity as conceiver; first conjunct anchors a coordinated root; ceased entities past; repeated noun mentions within a sentence are new nodes + coref (fixes contradiction); reciprocal relations as and; category noun before name is concept; no modal on connectives; no coref for generic nouns; event noun under aspectual verb is process with shared agent. Trimmed intro, section 1 overview, checklist for space.

Fix named-being/celestial rule contradiction, same-sentence repeat coref contradiction, temporal exemption for abstract-predicate content of saying verbs, entity status of list items/idioms in value slots, topic-noun conjunct headed by its relative verb, habitual-over-process for periodical nominals, existence verbs state, null-conceiver only when used, place postpositions, possessive pronoun no :possessor, 有/count-as lookup traps; trimmed redundant text for space.

Chinese framed adjectives/stative words become state events (have-mod-91 only frameless); quoted article titles as named publications; stronger whole-token/joined V+complement lookup and role traps; habitual narrowed to generic periodical activity; no node for 甚至/linking 还也/means verbs; general V+人/者 decomposition and 全/各 split; parts/content merged rule; compressions to stay under limit.

Add rules for quoted headlines as publication names, framed Chinese adjectives as ARG0 state events, ability/有-06, clause+时 and named occasions, 如 → have-example-91, reported-content temporal anchoring, and coref to nearest noun mention. Clause-linking reason/purpose nodes lose aspect and modal; purpose clauses re-enter the subject. Compress role lists, 4.2 and alignment text to fit the limit.

Compress verbose passages (identity-91 temporal block, abstract-predicate paragraph, aspectual relative, heads, stative rule, concept-name examples) to make room. Add: demonstrative+noun split; possessor-only role nouns not reified; publishing verb role numbers from frame; claim/position-holder senses; whole-token V+complement lookup; reified reason/purpose without aspect/modal; fronted purpose clause re-enters shared subject; temporal chaining of conjuncts, but-91 ARG1 anchor, no triple for dates inside reported content, means events overlap, no 时 node after named occasion; identity-91 under 能力 gets state; stance verbs state; no coref for generic kind nouns.
